SQLite Wasm JavaScript/TypeScript wrapper

Package: @sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm
Version: 3.53.4-build1
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm
License: Apache License 2.0

The package wraps the official SQLite Wasm build without changing it. SQLite
itself is in the public domain: https://sqlite.org/copyright.html
